query_manifest_json:
{
  "schema": "authenticated-connection-v133-2",
  "scope": "Unbounded active-connection exchanges for baseline 19 security queries; separate bounded lifecycle check with two serial SID sessions per connection and one reconnect. Phase2 once per connection. Sign(m); no report SID.",
  "models": [
    {
      "file": "pqc_authenticated_connection_v133.pv",
      "sha256": "e247f941918eb489f8ed64b5662dffbbd1e26f55466be7374d21e81781e33465",
      "queries": [
        {
          "id": "Q01",
          "kind": "secrecy",
          "query": "query x:bitstring,k:shared; event(SessionSecret(x,k)) && attacker(k).",
          "expected_printed_result": "true",
          "meaning": "Actual honest encapsulated shared secret is not derivable.",
          "match_events": [
            "SessionSecret"
          ],
          "injective": false
        },
        {
          "id": "Q02",
          "kind": "secrecy",
          "query": "query x:bitstring,k:kek; event(WrappingSecret(x,k)) && attacker(k).",
          "expected_printed_result": "true",
          "meaning": "Actual application wrapping key is not derivable.",
          "match_events": [
            "WrappingSecret"
          ],
          "injective": false
        },
        {
          "id": "Q03",
          "kind": "secrecy",
          "query": "query x:bitstring,k:contentKey; event(ContentSecret(x,k)) && attacker(k).",
          "expected_printed_result": "true",
          "meaning": "Actual content key is not derivable.",
          "match_events": [
            "ContentSecret"
          ],
          "injective": false
        },
        {
          "id": "Q04",
          "kind": "secrecy",
          "query": "query x:bitstring,m:bitstring; event(MessageSecret(x,m)) && attacker(m).",
          "expected_printed_result": "true",
          "meaning": "Fresh honest symbolic message is not derivable; not an indistinguishability query.",
          "match_events": [
            "MessageSecret"
          ],
          "injective": false
        },
        {
          "id": "Q05",
          "kind": "secrecy",
          "query": "query r:root; event(RootTX(r)) && attacker(r).",
          "expected_printed_result": "true",
          "meaning": "Enrolled TX response remains secret under ideal PUF/shared-use primitives.",
          "match_events": [
            "RootTX"
          ],
          "injective": false
        },
        {
          "id": "Q06",
          "kind": "secrecy",
          "query": "query r:root; event(RootRX(r)) && attacker(r).",
          "expected_printed_result": "true",
          "meaning": "Enrolled RX response remains secret under ideal PUF/shared-use primitives.",
          "match_events": [
            "RootRX"
          ],
          "injective": false
        },
        {
          "id": "Q07",
          "kind": "secrecy",
          "query": "query x:bitstring,k:dsaSK; event(SigningKey(x,k)) && attacker(k).",
          "expected_printed_result": "true",
          "meaning": "Actual TX signing-key term is not derivable.",
          "match_events": [
            "SigningKey"
          ],
          "injective": false
        },
        {
          "id": "Q08",
          "kind": "secrecy",
          "query": "query x:bitstring,k:kemSK; event(DecapsulationKey(x,k)) && attacker(k).",
          "expected_printed_result": "true",
          "meaning": "Actual RX KEM private-key term is not derivable; does not imply safety after d disclosure.",
          "match_events": [
            "DecapsulationKey"
          ],
          "injective": false
        },
        {
          "id": "Q09",
          "kind": "correspondence",
          "query": "query x:bitstring,pk:kemPK; event(TXCheckedRX(x,pk)) ==> event(IssuedRXKey(x,pk)).",
          "expected_printed_result": "true",
          "meaning": "TX checked RX key agrees with trusted authority issuance for the authenticated session record.",
          "match_events": [
            "TXCheckedRX",
            "IssuedRXKey"
          ],
          "injective": false
        },
        {
          "id": "Q10",
          "kind": "correspondence",
          "query": "query x:bitstring,pk:dsaPK; event(RXCheckedTX(x,pk)) ==> event(IssuedTXKey(x,pk)).",
          "expected_printed_result": "true",
          "meaning": "RX checked TX key agrees with trusted authority issuance for the authenticated session record.",
          "match_events": [
            "RXCheckedTX",
            "IssuedTXKey"
          ],
          "injective": false
        },
        {
          "id": "Q11",
          "kind": "correspondence",
          "query": "query x:bitstring,m:bitstring; event(RXAccepted(x,m)) ==> event(TXSigned(x,m)).",
          "expected_printed_result": "true",
          "meaning": "Protocol-level same-session origin under opaque reports, local SID-dependent wrapping and one-use receive continuation; NOT standalone signature binding.",
          "match_events": [
            "RXAccepted",
            "TXSigned"
          ],
          "injective": false
        },
        {
          "id": "Q12",
          "kind": "correspondence",
          "query": "query x:bitstring,m:bitstring; inj-event(RXAccepted(x,m)) ==> inj-event(RXRequested(x)).",
          "expected_printed_result": "true",
          "meaning": "Each acceptance corresponds injectively to a distinct RX request; relies on one-use state premise.",
          "match_events": [
            "RXAccepted",
            "RXRequested"
          ],
          "injective": true
        },
        {
          "id": "Q13",
          "kind": "correspondence",
          "query": "query x:bitstring,ss:shared,k:contentKey; event(RXAcceptedKey(x,ss,k)) ==> event(TXReadyKey(x,ss,k)).",
          "expected_printed_result": "true",
          "meaning": "RX accepted shared/content keys agree with actual TX prepared keys for the same session record.",
          "match_events": [
            "RXAcceptedKey",
            "TXReadyKey"
          ],
          "injective": false
        },
        {
          "id": "Q14",
          "kind": "correspondence",
          "query": "query x:bitstring,m:bitstring; event(RXAccepted(x,m)) ==> event(Phase2Passed(idTX,x)) && event(Phase2Passed(idRX,x)).",
          "expected_printed_result": "true",
          "meaning": "Acceptance follows both endpoints authentication for the live connection; session admission carries that authorization to a fresh SID.",
          "match_events": [
            "RXAccepted",
            "Phase2Passed"
          ],
          "injective": false
        },
        {
          "id": "Q15",
          "kind": "secrecy",
          "query": "query x:bitstring,r:coins; event(SigningCoins(x,r)) && attacker(r).",
          "expected_printed_result": "true",
          "meaning": "Actual honest signing coins are not derivable.",
          "match_events": [
            "SigningCoins"
          ],
          "injective": false
        },
        {
          "id": "Q16",
          "kind": "correspondence",
          "query": "query x:bitstring,m:bitstring; event(RXAccepted(x,m)) ==> event(TXSent(x,m)).",
          "expected_printed_result": "true",
          "meaning": "Accepted message corresponds to an actual TX send within the same authenticated session record.",
          "match_events": [
            "RXAccepted",
            "TXSent"
          ],
          "injective": false
        },

          "kind": "reachability",
          "query": "query x:bitstring,m:bitstring; event(TXSent(x,m)).",
          "expected_printed_result": "false",
          "meaning": "Honest sending is reachable.",
          "match_events": [
            "TXSent"
          ],
          "injective": false
        },
        {

          "expected_printed_result": "false",
          "meaning": "Honest acceptance is reachable.",
          "match_events": [
            "RXAccepted"
          ],
          "injective": false
        },

(* EXPOSED SIGNATURE DIAGNOSTIC v91, NOT the complete report protocol.
   One protected signing key, public (m,sig,record), arbitrary claimed identities,
   SID and epochs. The same verification key is deliberately reused for these
   claims to isolate standalone signature binding from key-distribution policy.
   Secrecy is intentionally not tested: m and sig are public in this scenario. *)
type uid.
type epoch.
type sessionid.
type root.
type coins.
type dsaPK.
type dsaSK.
type signature.
free c:channel.
free idTX,idRX,otherTX,otherRX:uid.
fun DSApk(root):dsaPK.
fun DSAsk(root):dsaSK.
fun Sign(dsaSK,bitstring,coins):signature.
reduc forall d:root,m:bitstring,r:coins;
 Verify(DSApk(d),m,Sign(DSAsk(d),m,r))=true.
fun SessionRecord(uid,uid,sessionid,epoch,epoch):bitstring [data].
event EvidenceSigned(bitstring,bitstring).
event EvidenceAccepted(bitstring,bitstring).
query rec:bitstring,m:bitstring;
 event(EvidenceAccepted(rec,m)) ==> event(EvidenceSigned(rec,m)).
query rec:bitstring,m:bitstring; event(EvidenceAccepted(rec,m)).
process
 new rootTX:root;
 out(c,DSApk(rootTX));
 (
  !(
   new s:sessionid; new et:epoch; new er:epoch;
   new m:bitstring; new r:coins;
   let rec=SessionRecord(idTX,idRX,s,et,er) in
   let sg=Sign(DSAsk(rootTX),m,r) in
   event EvidenceSigned(rec,m);
   out(c,(idTX,idRX,s,et,er,m,sg))
  ) |
  !(
   in(c,(tx:uid,rx:uid,s:sessionid,et:epoch,er:epoch,m:bitstring,sg:signature));
   let rec=SessionRecord(tx,rx,s,et,er) in
   if Verify(DSApk(rootTX),m,sg)=true then
   event EvidenceAccepted(rec,m)
  )
 )
